reason: I saw that TikTok and I'd grab free money if it was actually easy, but this is just a list that tells me to go read the official notice and file on some other site myself. I am not doing homework after work for a maybe-ten-dollar check.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? You are showing listings and making me check the official form, which is the part I never get around to.
would_change_my_mind: If it showed me a no-proof claim for a store or bank I actually use and I could tell in ten seconds I qualify, without making an account.
